planning_notes: Preserve all authoritative wiring, including the A1 soil sensor omitted from the partial device inventory. Empty supplied pins introduce no overrides.
Start in automatic mode with fan PWM zero, supplemental light off, pump off, alarm silent, and the temperature display selected. Manual mode initially selects the fan.

Buttons connect to ground using internal pullups. Their model values are already true when pressed. Implement debouncing and one action per press in SysML, maintaining the 250 ms command-response bound.

D2 toggles automatic/manual mode. In manual mode, successive D3 presses select light, pump, then fan. Manual updates affect only the selected actuator; other commands remain unchanged until selected or automatic mode resumes.

In automatic mode, clamp the fan command to zero at or below 25 degrees Celsius and 255 at or above 35 degrees Celsius, with a linear ramp between them. Enable the light below ADC 400 and the pump below soil ADC 400.

In manual mode, map A2 ADC 0..1023 linearly to fan PWM 0..255. For the selected light or pump, ADC values at or above 512 mean ON and lower values mean OFF. All conversion and selection logic belongs in SysML.

Cycle temperature, light, and soil display selection every 2000 ms using actual elapsed time. Display temperature as integer Celsius, assuming nearest-integer rounding, and light/soil as raw ADC counts. Reflect changes to the currently selected quantity within 250 ms.

Use the shared legal catalog-default DHT11 acquisition schedule, no faster than once per 2000 ms. Temperature and validity must describe the same acquisition; invalid acquisitions retain the last valid temperature.
A DHT validity failure or a light/soil ADC reading equal to 0 or 1023 is a sensor fault. The A2 potentiometer endpoints are valid manual commands, not sensor faults.
Assume a tone-driven buzzer and use a continuous 2000 Hz alarm while any sensor fault is active. Silence it when all faults clear.
Fault-report text and cadence were unspecified. Use the three labeled Boolean lines in one report group, emitted on fault entry or an active fault-set change; no periodic repeat is assumed.

Actuator behavior during sensor faults is unspecified. Assume the alarm and reports do not override actuator control; temperature control uses the retained last valid measurement. Before the first valid temperature acquisition, keep the automatic fan command zero.
The 5 ms period is scheduling granularity, not the display interval or a fabricated elapsed-time increment. Keep initialization within 500 ms without waiting for a valid DHT acquisition.
No serial receiver is required. All serial reporting uses 9600 baud; receive framing settings therefore do not introduce an additional interface.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
设计一个多模式智能温室控制系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、光敏电阻（A0）、土壤湿度传感器（A1）、风扇 PWM（D5）、补光 LED（D9）、水泵继电器（D10）、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2、D3。系统需要支持自动模式和手动模式：自动模式下根据温度、光照和土壤湿度分别控制风扇、补光灯和水泵；手动模式下通过按钮切换当前控制对象并用电位器 A2 调整其输出。TM1637 轮流显示温度、光照和土壤湿度；若任一传感器读数异常则蜂鸣器 D6 报警并通过串口输出故障信息。
Disclosed configurable bench choices for otherwise unspecified parameters: automatic fan mode at startup, relay outputs active HIGH, integer Celsius temperature and raw ADC light/soil display. Manual mode initially selects fan; each D3 press selects light,pump,fan in that order. A manual update changes only its selected actuator and retains the others until selected or auto mode resumes. PWM ramps from 0 at 25C to 255 at 35C, light turns on below ADC400, pump turns on below soil ADC400. D2 toggles auto/manual; D3 cycles fan,light,pump in manual, and A2 maps 0..1023 to PWM0..255 for fan or OFF/ON at ADC512 for the selected digital output. Display cycles temperature/light/soil every 2s. Sensor fault means invalid DHT acquisition or analog inputs railed at 0/1023; these analog endpoints are declared fault sentinels in this bench variant. Fault drives D6 and a Serial fault report. The existing pin conflict resolver and its recorded remaps are authoritative.

Operational acceptance profile operational-acceptance-v4 (additional public experimental conditions, not raw dataset text):
- Explicit original requirements and supplied circuit connections override every default below.
- Where no electrical wiring is supplied, individual LEDs are active HIGH to GND and buttons connect the named input to GND with INPUT_PULLUP; model pressed values are normalized independently of electrical level.
- When unspecified, a counter starts at zero and an LED starts OFF. An explicitly required ON state takes precedence.
- When the original gives no reaction deadline, a digital/button/serial command, PWM duty command or servo ANGLE COMMAND must update within 250ms of its input event becoming available. This does not impose physical motor travel time, shorten an explicit delay, or change a specified sensor/report period.
- When the original gives no display refresh period or response deadline, a changed input must be reflected in the display within 250ms. Explicit original display periods, delays and startup sequences override this default. This additional display bound was explicitly authorized for this experimental variant.
- Where the requirement asks to continuously stream a Boolean button/switch state over Serial but gives no repeat interval, respond to a changed state within 250ms and emit its correct state message at least once in every 500ms stable-state interval after settling. Explicit original report periods and event-only reporting rules override this default. This authorized additional continuous-state-report condition does not apply to startup-only messages, command echoes, sensor sampling or persistent display contents. A display retaining the correct visible state requires no repeated print calls unless the source explicitly requires redraws.
- Unless the original specifies a warmup or delayed startup, setup() must return within 500ms. Deadlines stated after initialization are measured from the observed setup() return, not power-on.
- An unspecified continuous DHT report must eventually emit a fresh valid reading within 3000ms of that measurement becoming available; explicit reporting periods override this bound.
